ledger.claim: The governing distance measurement is the trace, not the rounded copy. EV-GPS-02810 records trace_distance_km of 31.2 km over 245 fixes at 100.0% coverage, against a booked optimal of 24.0 km carried on EV-TRIP-02810. That is an excess of 7.2 km, or 30.0% of optimal. Under POL-RD-01 both establishment limbs are satisfied — the excess is greater than 20% of the optimal distance and greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms — so the route deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own evidence.

The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes, so no escalation under POL-RD-10(3) is available to the driver and the deviation may rest on the trace alone: EV-GPS-02810 has 245 fixes at a 10.0 s sample interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a max_gap_sec of 0.0, so none of POL-RD-07 limbs (a), (b) or (c) fires.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. EV-TRIP-02810, EV-GPS-02810 and EV-FARE-02810 all carry trip_id TRP-02810 and all describe the same 2026-08-20 evening trip from Northpoint City to Blk 503 Bishan St 11; and limb (b) is met by an excess of 7.2 km / 30.0% measured on a trace that is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c). The burden therefore shifts to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause.

The driver's only explanation on the record is the statement 'AYE closed, I had to divert', which cites no evidence ID and therefore carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Tested against the advisory for this trip and nothing else, as POL-RD-13 requires, it fails: POL-RD-03 limb (a) needs an advisory naming a road or segment that the optimal route traverses and limb (c) needs an actual route that leaves the optimal corridor before the affected segment and rejoins it after the fact, and the computed comparison on EV-GPS-02810 shows zero fixes inside the advisory area and a closest approach of 1699.49 m to it — the vehicle never enters the affected corridor at all.

Even taken at its highest, the driver's closure excuse is capped by POL-RD-03. The justified excess is the lesser of the measured excess and 1.30 x (shortest_lawful_alternative_km 26.0 - optimal_distance_km 24.0) + 1.00 km tolerance = 3.60 km, so min(7.2, 3.60) = 3.60 km. That leaves 3.60 km of the measured excess unjustified and refundable, and sets the closure-adjusted optimal at 27.6 km with a duration of 36.8 min.

The refund is arithmetic. EV-FARE-02810 records fare_model METERED, surge_multiplier 1.0 read from the fare_breakdown, and quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not run and POL-RD-02 governs. Against the booked optimal: (3.80 + 0.75 x 24.0 + 0.28 x 32.0) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 31.56. Charged_total is 39.40, so the refund is 7.84, rounded up to SGD 7.85 — 19.9% of charged_total, well clear of the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below the 90% full-refund share. That exceeds the SGD 7.50 the rider contested, so the rider is left carrying none of the disputed charge.

If the judge takes the closure at its highest and runs POL-RD-02 against the closure-adjusted optimal of 27.6 km and 36.8 min instead, the recomputed fare is 35.604 and the refund is 3.796, rounded up to SGD 3.80 — still above the SGD 0.50 de minimis. The rider is therefore entitled to a partial refund on either reading of the closure; the only live question is whether the unsupported closure excuse is worth the 4.05 difference between 3.80 and 7.85.

No part of the excess can be excluded as a rider-requested detour. POL-RD-04 requires a rider instruction recorded in the chat_log, with a resolvable waypoint_hint or a named road; EV-CHAT-02810 contains 0 messages, no first or last message time and no waypoint_hint, so the corroboration test cannot even be run and the clause is unavailable to the driver.

There is no amended endpoint to re-baseline the deviation against. EV-TRIP-02810 shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 has no stored amended re-quote and cannot be run; the booked optimal of 24.0 km stands as the baseline.

This is not a pooled trip. EV-TRIP-02810 records vehicle_type RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply and there is no matched-itinerary baseline and no co-rider collection distance to exclude; the full 7.2 km excess is measured against the 24.0 km solo optimal.

No pass-through correction adds to or subtracts from the distance refund: EV-FARE-02810 carries an empty erp_gantries list and empty erp_lines, and airport_surcharge 0.0, so there is no off-route ERP or wrongly applied surcharge to correct under POL-RD-09 and no risk of double-counting a pass-through line on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. The remedy is the distance refund and nothing else.

The rider's claim needs no corroboration beyond the trace. POL-RD-08's extra-corroboration condition fires only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more; EV-RPROF-02810 records deviation_claims_60d of 1 with deviation_claims_60d_substantiated of 0, so the condition is not met and this claim stands on the gps_trace as measured.

The driver's detour is explained by a live LTA advisory, not by choice. EV-ADVIS-02810-01 records a HIGH-severity vehicle fire with all lanes closed on the Ayer Rajah Expressway (AYE) towards Tuas after Clementi Ave 6, active 2026-08-20 20:39:44 to 22:15:24 — a 70.7 minute overlap with this trip's 21:09:44 to 21:50:24 running window — and the same record marks that advisory as intersecting the route the platform booked (intersects_route true, overlaps_trip_window true). The trace's own avoidance of the closure footprint (the derived advisory-area check records 0 fixes inside the advisory geometry) is what routing around a closed segment looks like. That satisfies POL-RD-03 limbs (a), (b) and (c), and by pointing to a specific artifact and a specific clause the driver discharges the burden POL-RD-08 places on him once the rider has shown an excess.

Exoneration under POL-RD-03 is capped, and the cap bites here. The justified excess is the lesser of the measured excess and 130% of the additional distance of the shortest lawful alternative plus 1.0 km of tolerance: min(7.2 km, 1.30 x (26.0 - 24.0) + 1.00) = min(7.2, 3.60) = 3.60 km. The closure-adjusted optimal route is therefore trip_record.optimal_distance_km + justified_excess = 24.0 + 3.60 = 27.60 km, with its duration scaled from the booked 32.0 minutes by 27.60/24.0 to 36.8 minutes. Only 3.60 km of the 7.2 km the rider complains of is chargeable to the driver on this clause; every figure comes from the record and none has to be invented.

Once the POL-RD-03 adjustment is made, POL-RD-01 tests the excess that REMAINS, measured on the governing trace figure of 31.2 km: 31.2 - 27.60 = 3.60 km, which is 13.0% of the 27.60 km adjusted optimal. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH limbs to pass — more than 20% of the optimal distance AND more than 0.8 km absolute — and the percentage limb fails, so the route deviation is not established at all. The clause is explicit that where either establishment test fails no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip; the CHARGED fare and the nil refund therefore stand as they are, which is the party-relative effect POL-GEN-03 gives NO_ACTION on a rider-filed dispute.

If the judge takes the other view and treats the residual excess as refundable, the quantum is still far below the rider's number. POL-RD-02 directs that where POL-RD-03 excuses part of the excess the recomputation runs against the ADJUSTED optimal route, not the booked one: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 27.60 + 0.28 x 36.8) x the 1.0 surge multiplier recorded on the fare breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = 35.604, so the refund is 39.40 - 35.604 = 3.796, payable 3.80 after rounding up to the nearest SGD 0.05. That is 9.6% of charged_total, nowhere near the 90% that would trigger FULL_REFUND, and the 7.85 an unadjusted computation would produce is not available on this record.

Nothing may be added on top of the distance refund. The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines and an ERP and toll total of SGD 0.00, and POL-RD-09(1) provides that off-route pass-through charges are already comprehended in a POL-RD-02 refund, itemised for transparency only and never added to it. There is no separate pass-through or billing-integrity correction to make on this trip.

No repeat-deviation uplift is available against the driver. The deviation is not MATERIAL on any view: the measured excess of 7.2 km is below the 8.0 km absolute materiality figure and 30.0% is below the 50% percentage figure in POL-RD-01, so the POL-RD-06 profile check is not even engaged. And on the only fields POL-RD-06 and POL-GEN-01 permit for that test, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 196 completed trips in 90 days (a ratio of 0.0, far below the 0.05 threshold and the 3-flag count), so no pattern is established, no FULL_REFUND uplift applies, and no driver-conduct referral arises.

The GPS trace is unimpaired both at the schema level and under POL-RD-07's own limbs — 100.0% coverage, 245 fixes at a 10 second sample interval, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, all well inside the 90 second, 500 m and 30 second thresholds. The excess and the closure arithmetic therefore rest on clean telemetry, and there is no gap-driven reason to depart from or discount the figures computed on EV-GPS-02810.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this is a provisional, automated ruling on trip TRP-02810 (Northpoint City to Blk 503 Bishan St 11, 20 Aug 2026). The rider is partly right.

1. A deviation exists. Measured on the governing trace field (EV-GPS-02810, trace_distance_km 31.2 km, 245 fixes, 10 s sampling, 100% coverage, no gaps, max_gap 0.0 s), against the booked optimal of 24.0 km (EV-TRIP-02810), the excess is 7.2 km, or 30.0% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 limbs pass (30.0% > 20% and 7.2 km > 0.8 km), so the deviation is established. The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c), so no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises and the trace alone may carry the measurement.

2. The driver's excuse applies, but only up to its cap. The bare statement 'AYE closed, I had to divert' cites no evidence ID and carries no weight by itself under POL-RD-08. But the advisory it refers to is on file: EV-ADVIS-02810-01 (LTA DataMall; Ayer Rajah Expressway towards Tuas after Clementi Ave 6; HIGH-severity vehicle fire, all lanes closed; 20:39:44-22:15:24), overlapping this trip's 21:09:44-21:50:24 window and recorded as intersecting the booked route. POL-RD-03 is therefore available and excuses part of the excess. The justified excess is min(7.2 km, 1.30 x (26.0 - 24.0) + 1.00) = min(7.2, 3.60) = 3.60 km, so the closure-adjusted optimal is 24.0 + 3.60 = 27.60 km, with duration 32.0 x 27.60/24.0 = 36.8 min.

3. The driver's argument that the 3.60 km left over is too small to refund (13.0% of 27.60 km) is not accepted. POL-RD-01 is satisfied on the measured excess (7.2 km, 30.0%), and POL-RD-03 states in terms that the excess beyond the cap is not exonerated and is refunded under POL-RD-02 computed against the closure-adjusted optimal route - that is exactly this residue. POL-RD-01's 'excess remaining' rule governs the materiality tier (POL-RD-06), which 3.60 km does not reach. Reading POL-RD-01 to re-test establishment on the adjusted optimal would defeat POL-RD-03's express refund in the very cases its cap exists to police.

4. Refund. The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-02810) and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not run and POL-RD-02 governs; surge_multiplier 1.0 is read from the fare breakdown. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 27.60 + 0.28 x 36.8) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 surcharge + 0.00 waiting - 0.00 promo = 35.604. Charged_total = 39.40. Refund = 39.40 - 35.604 = 3.796, rounded up to SGD 3.80. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and only 9.6% of the fare, so this is a partial refund, not a full one. The rider's higher figure of 7.85 (recomputation against the booked 24.0 km optimal) is not available: the closure-excused stretch comes out before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied.

5. Nothing is added on top, and nothing else excuses the trip. EV-FARE-02810 carries no ERP gantry lines and no airport surcharge (0.00), so there is no separate POL-RD-09 pass-through or billing-integrity correction and no risk of double-counting. There is no rider-requested detour to exclude: EV-CHAT-02810 holds 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 cannot be run. There is no amended endpoint (POL-RD-05 not runnable), and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The deviation is not material and the driver has no trailing-window pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0 of 196 completed trips), so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. The rider's claim needs no extra corroboration (deviation_claims_60d 1, below the POL-RD-08 trigger).

6. Confidence 0.85: the trace, trip record, fare breakdown and advisory all carry weight_multiplier 1.0, so the cap is 1.0. The monetary effect (SGD 3.80) does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue. Either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
